messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync 1010 — need to finalize webinar topic and registration fields by EOD. Two topic options on the table: A) "Serving LLMs at Production Scale" (runtime + routing + fallbacks) B) "Lowering Per-Token Cost Without Sacrificing Quality" (quantization, batching, caching). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Eli Navarro: I vote A. It's a clearer ops story for platform teams. B is great but maybe a deep-dive follow-up.
Ravi Patel: +1 A. We can sneak cost controls into the takeaways. Also need to pick a working abstract so copy can go to landing page.
Jordan Lee: As moderator I'd prefer A too 10. Easier to structure Qs.
Priya Singh: Topic locked as A then. For registration we should capture: email, company, job role, deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private), ARR bucket, and whether they want the post-event benchmark. That should give SDRs enough context.
Sam O'Neill: Routing rule idea: form -> HubSpot property "webinar_topic" = "scaling_ops"; then HubSpot workflow: if ARR >= 50k -> tag AE, else SDR nurture. Also set first-touch campaign = "webinar_2026_scaling".
Maya Chen: Draft abstract (Ravi please refine):
``
Serving LLMs at Production Scale
Learn how teams keep latency low and costs predictable while serving modern LLMs. Engineers from Redwood will walk through routing policies, caching and batching tactics, and rollout patterns that reduce incidents and unit cost. Includes live demo and a downloadable benchmark report.
Who should attend: infra/platform/ML engineers and engineering managers.
Takeaways: concrete SLO tuning tips, a checklist for fallbacks, and a reproducible demo.
``
Ravi Patel: Updated and shortened on Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Replaced "downloadable benchmark" with "benchmark report" and added CTA to request the repo.
Eli Navarro: Speakers proposed: Ravi (runtime + kernels), Alex Torres (routing + fallbacks + demo), Jordan (moderator/panel). Need backup for Alex demo — recommend recording full demo and Ravi as live backup.
Jordan Lee: For run-of-show I'm proposing 40 minutes: 5min host, 12min Ravi, 12min Alex, 6min demo, 5min live Qs, remainder for wrap and CTAs. If we need a shorter variant, swap demo to pre-recorded 3min clip.
Priya Singh: Registration copy tweak: change "Who should attend" to "For engineering teams building latency-sensitive LLM features". Add checkbox: "Send me the benchmark report and demo repo". Also GDPR opt-in language required for EU registrants.
Sam O'Neill: I'll set up the HubSpot form. Two notes: 1) hidden field utm_campaign=webinar_scaling_2026, 2) add dropdown 'Deployment interest' with values Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Once form is live I'll post the webhook sample to this thread.
Maya Chen: Rehearsal windows:
- Tue 10:00 PT: full run (all presenters + host)
- Thu 09:00 PT: tech-check (audio/video + demo infra)
Please confirm availability now.
Ravi Patel: Confirm Tue + Thu. I'll upload fallback.mp4 (full demo recording) to Drive by Monday EOD.
Eli Navarro: I can do both rehearsals. Will prep 3 slide prompts for panel.
Jordan Lee: Moderator prep: three opening questions and a 2-line closing summary. Also need host cue sheet (timers, slide numbers).
Priya Singh: Lead routing specifics: tag HubSpot lead with properties: webinar=serving_llms, interest=deployment_value, arr_bucket (0-10k,10-50k,50k+). Workflow: if arr_bucket=50k+ and role contains "engineer" or "platform" -> AE outreach. Else -> SDR 24h nurture email + recording.
Sam O'Neill: AE rounding threshold confirmed. I'll also create a Slack channel webhook: #webinar-leads where high-priority leads (50k+ OR product intent checkbox ticked) get posted instantly. Low-priority leads go to daily digest.
Maya Chen: Demo fallback plan: 1) pre-recorded video available (fallback.mp4), 2) CLI snippet slide to run a quick local curl if remote GPU is flakey, 3) narrate architecture slides if demo times out.
Ravi Patel: Smoke test steps saved in Drive > marketing > webinars > scaling_ops > demo_checklist.md. Short version: start container, run `curl -s localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' | jq '.latency'` and verify < 250ms.
Jordan Lee: Moderator will have a 'panic question' to buy time if demo hiccups. 'How do you prioritize fallbacks when SLOs slip?' Good segue to slides.
Priya Singh: Post-event follow-up: immediate recording email + link to benchmark report gated by an email capture landing page (same HubSpot contact). Also send a 1-click poll in 48h for interest in a half-day workshop.
Eli Navarro: Good call on workshop CTA. Could route heavy-interest respondents to AE.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: Webinar "Serving LLMs at Production Scale" 14 60 Tue 2026-07-14 16:00 UTC. Link: https://calendar.example/event/def456
Maya Chen: Action items recap:
- Ravi: finalize abstract + upload fallback.mp4 + demo checklist (due Mon EOD)
- Sam: HubSpot form + webhook + Slack routing (due Tue 2pm PT)
- Priya: Registration copy + GDPR text + post-event poll (due Mon EOD)
- Jordan: moderator cue sheet + panic Qs (due Tue 9am PT)
- Eli: slide prompts + panel flow (due Mon EOD)
If anyone needs to swap slots ping me. We'll mark this thread resolved after assets are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
